# Briefs

The standing text a hand dispatch puts in front of an issue's body (`gh workflow run dispatch.yml -f task=...`):

- `implement.md`: implement and fix runs;
- `triage.md`: triage of a board item;
- `secret-strings.md`: appended to every brief.

They live here instead of in one session's home directory, so any session, or a hosted helper, dispatches with the same text.
